songs.title: Riha
songs.content:
Capo: 3
C Am C G

Hmm, Rait pe pairon se tere nishaan mere dil par
Logon ki lehron si hai baaton se mitenge kab-tak
Ho jaana tu riha mere, ho jaana tu riha mere
Na hona chahun main, na ho sakun kabhi

songs.title: Mishri
songs.content:
No Capo
G D Em C

Yeh palkon mein kuch baate hain
Tere bina, tere bina
Adhri si, saari raatein hain
Tere bina, tera bina

songs.title: Alag Aasman
songs.content:
Capo 6
C F G C

Nayi nahi hain ye baatein wahi
Phir is modh par hum milein hain
Naa jaane ab milenge hum kabhi
To ruk jao ek pal yahan pe

songs.title: Baarishein
songs.content:
D Bm G D A

Holay se, Dheeme se
Mujh ko baahon mai bhar lo na tum
Narm si, Sanson mai
Mujh ko aahon mai bhar lo na tum

songs.title: Gul
songs.content:
Capo 6
Am Em F G

Na dastakein
Yeh tere dil ki haan wahi dhadkane hai
Yoon zor se jo tujhko ab sun rahin hai

songs.title: Husn
songs.content:
Capo 5
F C E7 Am G

Dekho Dekho Kaisi baatein yahan ki
Hain saath par Hain saath na bhi
Kya itni aasaan hain?

songs.title: Tum Hi Ho
songs.content:
Capo 1
Em C D Bm

Hum tere bin ab reh nahi sakte
Tere bina kya wajood mera?
Tujhse juda gar ho jayenge
To khudse hi ho jayenge juda

Kyunki tum hi ho, ab tum hi ho
Zindagi ab tum hi ho

songs.title: Aasan Nahi Yahan
songs.content:
Am G F G

Aasan nahin yahan aashiq ho jana
Palko pe kaaton ko sajaana
Aashiq ko milti hai gam ki saugaatein
Sabko na milta yeh khazana

songs.title: Chunar
songs.content:
E Am D E

O jheena jheena jheena re udaa gulaal
Maai teri chunariya lehraai
Rang teri reet ka, Rang teri preet ka
Maai teri chunariya lehraayi

songs.title: Khamoshiyan
songs.content:
Am C Em Dm F G

Khamoshiyan aawaaz hain
Tum sun'ne to aao kabhi
Chhukar tumhe khill jaayengi
Ghar inko bulaao kabhi

songs.title: Aadat
songs.content:
Bm A G A

Juda hoke bhi, Tu mujh mein kahin baaki hai
Palkon mein ban ke aason, Tu chali aati hai
Juda hoke bhi

songs.title: Kuch Is Tarah
songs.content:
F Am C Dm

Kuch Is Tarah, Teri Palke
Meri Palko se Mila De
Ansu Tere, Saare
Meri Palko pe SaJaa De

songs.title: Pehli Nazar Mein
songs.content:
Capo 2
Em D C D

Pehli nazar mein Kaise jaado kar diya
Tera ban baita hai mera jiya
Jaane kya hoga Kya hoga kya pata

songs.title: Tu Jaane Na
songs.content:
Capo 5
C Am Dm G

Kaise batayein Kyun tujhko chahe
Yaara bata na paayein
Tu jaane na, Tu jaane na

songs.title: Woh Lamhe Woh Baatein
songs.content:
Am G F G

Woh lamhe, woh baatein, Koi na jaane
Thi kaisi raatein, barsaatein
Woh bheegi bheegi yaadein

songs.title: Kya Mujhe Pyaar Hai
songs.content:
Em D C D

Kyon Aaj Kal neend kam Khwab zaada hai
Lagta Khuda ka koi neek iraada hai
Kya Mujhe Pyaar hai ya Kaisa Khumar hai ya

songs.title: Tu Hi Meri Shab Hai
songs.content:
Am G F Am

Tu hi meri shab hai subah hai tu hi din hai mera
Tu hi mera rab hai jahaan hai tu hi meri duniya

songs.title: Khuda Jaane
songs.content:
Am G F C D

Sajde mein yun hi jhukta hoon
Tum pe hi aa ke rukta hoon
Khuda jaane ke mein fida hun

songs.title: Hai Junoon
songs.content:
D A G A Bm

Yaaro jee bhar ke jee le pal
Lagta hai aaj kal daur apna aayega
Hai junoon sa jeene mein

songs.title: Kasoor
songs.content:
Capo 6
C F G Dm7 Am7

Haan, main gumsum hoon In raahon ki tarah
Tere zulfon ki ye nami Teri aankhon ka ye nashaa
Kya kasoor hai ye mera
